production.waterSource: Production water is drawn from Loch Ardnahoe, described by the distillery as exceptionally soft water filtered through peat and rock.
production.malt: The distillery states its malt is dried over peat smoke for around 20 hours before milling in a 100-year-old Vickers Boby mill.
production.fermentation: Fermentation takes place in four Oregon pine washbacks. Ardnahoe states a total fermentation time of approximately 65-70 hours, with the wash settling after about 50 hours before the extended fermentation completes.
production.stills: Two lantern-shaped copper pot stills made by Speyside Copperworks are used: a 13,000-litre wash still and an 11,000-litre spirit still. Both employ unusually long descending lyne arms and traditional worm-tub condensers, with the distillery emphasising slow, gentle distillation.
production.peat: Peat smoke is used during malt drying for around 20 hours, establishing a deliberately peated Islay spirit style.
production.maturation: The distillery highlights direct sourcing of American white-oak bourbon casks from the United States and European-oak Oloroso sherry casks from Jerez as core maturation wood types.

houseCharacter: Ardnahoe combines peated malt with a relatively long 65-70 hour fermentation designed to generate a fruitier wash before distillation. Large lantern-shaped stills, long descending lyne arms and slow distillation into worm tubs favour texture and weight while retaining fruit and peat. Bourbon and Oloroso sherry casks then provide a structured maturation framework around that fruity, peaty and textural new make.
cask23Narrative: Ardnahoe is one of the clearest examples of a modern Islay distillery built around traditional hardware. Its four Oregon pine washbacks and 65-70 hour fermentation aim to create a fruitier wash, while unusually long lyne arms and worm tubs give the spirit a weightier, more textural shape. In the glass, that makes the distillery particularly interesting for customers who enjoy peat but also want fruit, density and cask-driven richness rather than smoke alone.
